issue: typer 0.25.1 dropped the [all] extra; pyproject.toml had `typer[all]>=0.9`. pip install emitted: WARNING: typer 0.25.1 does not provide the extra 'all'.

fix_diff.explanation: typer >=0.12 removed [all] because rich + shellingham are bundled directly. We pin >=0.12 to escape the legacy extra path. Also explicitly declare shellingham (was implicit via [all]) for forward compat in case typer ever unbundles it. `rich>=13.7` was already explicit.

compatibility.typer_dropped_all_extra_in: ~0.12 (per typer changelog; exact minor uncertain — the >= bound is conservative)
compatibility.shellingham_was_implied_by: typer[all]; now explicit so we don't break if typer ever removes the bundle

validation_commands: pip install -e . --quiet  →  no `does not provide the extra 'all'` warning
